overview: Dace attempts the impossible: a peaceful walk without his phone. But his device, Phoney Bunny, springs to life and chases him like a clingy ex. As he recruits fellow screen junkies, one question remains: can you live without your phone?
tagline: Dace thought “unplugging” would be a walk in the park, but when his phone comes to life and chases him down, he learns that he just might be a little bit… addicted to it.
title: Addicted to It

data.overview: Dace intenta lo imposible: dar un paseo tranquilo sin su teléfono. Pero su dispositivo, Phoney Bunny, cobra vida y lo persigue como una exnovia insistente. Mientras recluta a otros adictos a las pantallas, una pregunta persiste: ¿se puede vivir sin el teléfono?
